SELECT oid, datname, datcollate, pg_encoding_to_char(encoding) AS encoding FROM pg_database WHERE datname = current_database()
CREATE EXTENSION pageinspect
CREATE EXTENSION pg_freespacemap
CREATE EXTENSION pg_visibility
CREATE EXTENSION pg_buffercache
CREATE EXTENSION pg_walinspect
CREATE TABLE users (id int NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, name char(50) NOT NULL, age smallint NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX idx_name ON users (name)
CREATE INDEX idx_age ON users (age)

INSERT INTO users SELECT i, CASE WHEN i = 2050 THEN 'Alice' ELSE 'User' || lpad(i::text, 5, '0') || '-abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMN' END, CASE WHEN i = 2050 THEN 42 ELSE 18 + i %% 63 END FROM generate_series(%s::int, %s::int) AS i

INSERT INTO users SELECT i, CASE WHEN i = 2050 THEN 'Alice' ELSE 'User' || lpad(i::text, 5, '0') || '-abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMN' END, CASE WHEN i = 2050 THEN 42 ELSE 18 + i %% 63 END FROM generate_series(%s::int, %s::int) AS i
SELECT ctid::text AS ctid, xmin::text AS xmin, * FROM users WHERE id = 2050

INSERT INTO users SELECT i, CASE WHEN i = 2050 THEN 'Alice' ELSE 'User' || lpad(i::text, 5, '0') || '-abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMN' END, CASE WHEN i = 2050 THEN 42 ELSE 18 + i %% 63 END FROM generate_series(%s::int, %s::int) AS i
SELECT c.relname, c.relkind, c.oid, c.relfilenode, pg_relation_filepath(c.oid) AS path FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relname IN ('users', 'users_pkey', 'idx_name', 'idx_age') ORDER BY c.oid
CHECKPOINT
SELECT count(*) AS rows, pg_relation_size('users') AS heap_bytes, pg_relation_size('users') / 8192 AS heap_pages FROM users
SELECT (ctid::text::point)[0]::int AS blk, count(*) AS rows, min(id) AS first_id, max(id) AS last_id FROM users GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT ctid::text AS ctid, xmin::text AS xmin, xmax::text AS xmax, id, name, length(name) AS len, octet_length(name) AS octets, age, pg_column_size(name) AS name_size, pg_column_size(users.*) AS row_size FROM users WHERE id = 2050
SELECT ctid::text AS ctid, id, name, age, pg_column_size(name) AS name_size, pg_column_size(users.*) AS row_size FROM users WHERE id IN (1, 2049, 2051, 4096) ORDER BY id
SELECT 'users' AS rel, pg_relation_size('users', 'main') AS main, pg_relation_size('users', 'fsm') AS fsm, pg_relation_size('users', 'vm') AS vm, pg_relation_size('users', 'init') AS init

SELECT 'users_pkey' AS rel, pg_relation_size('users_pkey', 'main') AS main, pg_relation_size('users_pkey', 'fsm') AS fsm, pg_relation_size('users_pkey', 'vm') AS vm, pg_relation_size('users_pkey', 'init') AS init

SELECT 'idx_name' AS rel, pg_relation_size('idx_name', 'main') AS main, pg_relation_size('idx_name', 'fsm') AS fsm, pg_relation_size('idx_name', 'vm') AS vm, pg_relation_size('idx_name', 'init') AS init
SELECT 'idx_age' AS rel, pg_relation_size('idx_age', 'main') AS main, pg_relation_size('idx_age', 'fsm') AS fsm, pg_relation_size('idx_age', 'vm') AS vm, pg_relation_size('idx_age', 'init') AS init
SELECT * FROM bt_metap('users_pkey')
SELECT pg_relation_size('users_pkey') / 8192 AS n

SELECT * FROM bt_metap('idx_name')
